_help: A-26 crafting stations (scripts/Stations.cs, scripts/UiStations.cs, scripts/UiCraft.cs). Crafting is done on a grid at a station block within 'range' metres (Interact on the block opens it): 'hand' is the 2x2 grid in the pack (recipes flagged "hand": true in data/blocks.json 'recipes'), the crafting table makes blocks, tools and furniture, the smithing table gear (and opens the smith's bench: hone, reroll, repair), the alchemy table potions, soul cubes and pet gear, the forge smelts. 'tabs' = which recipe lists a station shows (the old Crafting window tabs: blocks, gear, elem, sets, gems, pots; hand = the hand subset of blocks). A recipe is shaped (data 'shape' + 'key') or shapeless (the grid holds exactly its cost materials); the recipe book on the right fills the grid for you. forge: a furnace per forge block with an input, a fuel and an output stack ('slot' = most per stack) that keeps smelting while you are away (play time); fuel = seconds one unit burns; smelt: the plain one-ingredient recipes only (the iron ratios follow data/durability.json 'smelt'; alloys with several ingredients are smelted at the smith's bench); input material -> { need: units per batch, out: what a batch gives, n: how many, time: seconds per batch, xp: smithing XP }. potions: brewed at the alchemy table into the materials 'pot_<id>' (names and gold values in data/gather.json), drunk by clicking them in the pack (Materials): heal / mana / stamina = share of the maximum restored at once, buff = stat-table keys for dur seconds (Player.Buffs, id 'potion:<id>', a second dose refreshes it), light = metres of soft light that follows the hero for dur seconds (night vision), xp = crafting XP.
